hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Kestrel Group Life Assurance pays a lump sum to a member's nominated beneficiaries if the member dies while covered under a participating employer's scheme. Cover is provided under a group policy issued to the employer or retirement fund.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text:
- Members must be permanent employees of the participating employer.
- The maximum entry age is 64. Cover ends at the scheme's normal retirement age, or age 65 at the latest.
- Members must be actively at work on the date cover starts. If not, cover starts on the date they return to full duties.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age has 60 days from leaving service to apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy, without providing medical evidence. The cover under this option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: The member has 60 days from leaving service to apply, and cover is limited to the lower of group cover and R5 000 000, without medical evidence.
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

caveats: The excerpt says the application must be received within 60 days of leaving service, so the caller should be told it is the date the application is received, not the date it is posted. The excerpt covers the 2026 Group Life Product Guide (current edition).

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer: Under Option C, a member earning R50 000 a month would receive R42 500 a month. This is 100% of the first R20 000 of monthly salary plus 75% of the balance, subject to the R300 000 maximum monthly benefit, which this amount is below. The benefit starts after a 3-month waiting period. This is an illustration of the general rule; the claims team decides individual cases.

question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?

result.question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?
result.answer: The Kestrel Group Disability Income benefit is paid monthly in arrears until the earliest of: the member's recovery, the member's death, or the member reaching age 65. So the latest it is paid is up to age 65, and it stops earlier if the member recovers or dies first.

question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?

result.question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?
result.answer: To submit a disability claim, the Kestrel Claims FAQ lists these documents: a completed Kestrel disability claim form (with the employer section and the member section), a medical report from the treating doctor, the member's last 3 payslips, and a certified copy of the member's ID document. Claims should be submitted as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. Claims can be sent by the employer or broker through the Kestrel Broker Portal or by email to claims@kestrel-assurance.example.

question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?

result.question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?
result.answer: The documents do not state a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members. They do show that a 150-member scheme falls in the 100 to 249 members band, which has a group life free cover limit of R 3 500 000. The Group Life Product Guide says premiums are expressed as a percentage of the total annual salary bill of covered members, not as a rate per R1 000 of cover.
result.reason: The approved documents do not contain a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for any scheme size. For the rate for this scheme, ask the broker or scheme administrator, or underwriting for cover above the limits.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Kestrel Group Life Assurance pays a lump sum to a member's nominated beneficiaries if the member dies while covered under a participating employer's scheme. Cover is provided under a group policy issued to the employer or retirement fund.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text:
- Members must be permanent employees of the participating employer.
- The maximum entry age is 64. Cover ends at the scheme's normal retirement age, or age 65 at the latest.
- Members must be actively at work on the date cover starts. If not, cover starts on the date they return to full duties.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age can apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: The 60-day deadline to apply and the cover limit (lower of group cover and R5 000 000) for the continuation option.
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

caveats: The cover figure is a cap: the member gets the lower of their group cover and R5 000 000, so a member with less group cover gets less. The source is the 2026 Group Life Product Guide (current edition).

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer: Under Option C, a member earning R50 000 a month would receive R42 500 a month: 100% of the first R20 000 of salary, plus 75% of the remaining R30 000. This is subject to the Option C maximum monthly benefit of R300 000, and the benefit starts after the 3-month waiting period. This is an illustration of the general rule, not a decision on any individual member's claim, which the claims team decides.

question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?

result.question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?
result.answer: The Kestrel Group Disability Income Benefit is paid monthly in arrears until the earliest of: the member's recovery, the member's death, or the member reaching age 65. So the benefit stops at age 65 at the latest, or earlier if the member recovers or dies first.

question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?

result.question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?
result.answer: A disability claim needs: a completed Kestrel disability claim form (employer section and member section), a medical report from the treating doctor, the member's last 3 payslips, and a certified copy of the member's ID document. The claim should be submitted as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. Claims can be sent by the employer or broker through the Kestrel Broker Portal or by email to claims@kestrel-assurance.example.

question: How long does Kestrel take to make a decision on a group life claim?

result.question: How long does Kestrel take to make a decision on a group life claim?
result.answer: Kestrel aims to make a decision on a group life claim within 10 working days of receiving all required documents. This is a target, not a guarantee, and the clock starts only once all required documents have been received.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age can apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: Member has 60 days from leaving service to apply; cover is the lower of group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

caveats: The 60-day limit runs from leaving service and the cover is capped at the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000, so the R5 000 000 figure is not automatically available. The documents do not say how the application is treated if it is received after 60 days; the claims or underwriting team decides individual cases.

question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?

result.question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?
result.answer: The Kestrel Group Disability Income Benefit is paid monthly in arrears until the earliest of: the member's recovery, the member's death, or the member reaching age 65. So the benefit stops at age 65 at the latest, or earlier if the member recovers or dies first.

question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?

result.question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?
result.answer:
The documents do not state a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members. The only premium rule found is that group life premiums are a percentage of the total annual salary bill of covered members, guaranteed for 2 years from the scheme commencement or review date. For a scheme of 150 members (band 3, 100 to 249 members), the documents give a group life free cover limit of R 3 500 000, but no per-R1 000 rate.</answer>

hit.title: Claims Frequently Asked Questions (updated March 2026)
hit.locator: section "How long does it take to assess a claim?"
heading_path: How long does it take to assess a claim?
hit.text: Kestrel aims to make a decision on group life claims within 10 working days of receiving all required documents. Disability claims may take longer because medical information may need to be obtained. Funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of receiving complete documents.

hit.title: Claims Frequently Asked Questions (updated March 2026)
hit.locator: section "What if I am unhappy with a claim decision?"
heading_path: What if I am unhappy with a claim decision?
hit.text: You can ask for the decision to be reviewed by writing to complaints@kestrel-assurance.example within 90 days of the decision. If you are still not satisfied, you may refer the matter to the long-term insurance ombud.

hit.title: Group Disability Income Benefit Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
heading_path: Group Disability Income Benefit: Product Guide
hit.text: Claims should be submitted as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. See the Kestrel Claims FAQ for the documents required.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: The death of a member must be notified to Kestrel within 6 months of the date of death. Claims notified later may be declined. See the Kestrel Claims FAQ for the documents required.

hit.title: Group Funeral Benefit Scheme Rules (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of Kestrel receiving all the required documents.

hit.title: Claims Frequently Asked Questions (updated March 2026)
hit.locator: section "Can I check the status of a claim?"
heading_path: Can I check the status of a claim?
hit.text: Yes. Employers and brokers can track claims on the Broker Portal. Members can call the Kestrel Client Centre on 0800 000 000 (fictitious number), Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00.
